verdict.rationale: Otter documents a first-party MCP Server that connects meeting data to AI tools like Claude and ChatGPT. It uses OAuth authentication with granular permissions and lets an assistant search transcripts and analyze patterns across meetings, confirmed by a dedicated blog page and probe. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the MCP server, and detailed setup or tool-reference documentation beyond marketing-level descriptions.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: Otter's MCP Server connects your meeting data directly to AI tools like Claude and ChatGPT, bringing your meeting intelligence into your everyday AI workflows.
Connect Otter.ai meeting transcripts and action items to Claude via MCP. Search, recap, and draft follow-ups without leaving the chat.
OAuth-authenticated with granular permissions. Your AI assistant can only access meetings you explicitly authorize
ChatGPT, Claude, and other AI chat tools can securely access your meeting knowledge through Otter's MCP Server for deeper analysis and smarter workflows.
